items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, tops Artificial Analysis index at 65 points
items.summary: Fable 5.2 leads the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 65 points, ahead of Gemini 4 Carbon (60) and Opus 5.5 (59). Pricing drops 20% to $8/$40 per million tokens with an optional 2.5x fast mode. Mythos 5.2 stays restricted to vetted organizations.
items.why: This is Anthropic's biggest model jump since Fable 5, landing two days before its IPO roadshow. Double-digit benchmark gains in coding and science, a 20% price cut, and new fast mode directly challenge GPT-6 Astra and Gemini 4 Carbon.

items.headline: Anthropic begins IPO roadshow, targets $70-78 per share on Nasdaq under ticker ANT
items.summary: Anthropic is offering 825M Class A shares on the Nasdaq Global Select Market, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley leading. The registration statement has been filed with the SEC but is not yet effective.

items.headline: FT: Anthropic bought $3.4B of pre-ordered gas generators from OnePWR for data center power
items.summary: Anthropic acquired commitments for 1.7 GW of Caterpillar gas generators that OnePWR had pre-ordered two years ago. Piper Sandler confirmed the sale but neither company has publicly named the buyer.

items.headline: OpenAI deploys Control Room, a system that can halt any research model workload in 35 seconds
items.summary: Control Room tracks every research inference workload and stops model output within 35 seconds of a halt decision. The system fails closed: if Control Room goes down, all inference requests are denied until it recovers.

items.headline: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace
items.summary: Organizations can buy and manage ChatGPT Enterprise through existing AWS billing, with eligible spend counting toward AWS commitments. ChatGPT for Healthcare and Financial Services are also listed.

items.headline: Google adds Maps Platform to AI Studio Build with prompt-based setup and a free sandbox
items.summary: AI Studio Build now lets developers add Google Maps to Gemini-built apps with text prompts and a free 100-call daily sandbox per API. Supported APIs include Maps, Places, Routes and Environment.
